name: Johan Danielsson - § 4/2
title: REPORT on addressing subcontracting chains and the role of intermediaries in order to protect workers’ rights
part_text: and to consider introducing a well-defined regime for the joint and several liability of economic operators and subcontractors and for ensuring transparency regarding the subcontractors involved and the share of the contract that the contractor intends to subcontract
part_context: Reiterates its call on the Commission, in order to end abusive subcontracting and to protect workers’ rights, to strengthen transparency and accountability throughout the supply chain, and to consider introducing a well-defined regime for the joint and several liability of economic operators and subcontractors and for ensuring transparency regarding the subcontractors involved and the share of the contract that the contractor intends to subcontract[[30]](#footnote-30);
